description: Permanently delete one or multiple records by primary key. Irreversible destructive operation enforcing RLS permissions. Pass `item` for a single delete OR `items` for batch deletion (not both). Each object only needs the primary key field (e.g. `{ "customer_feedbackid": 1 }`; other fields are ignored). Bulk deletes are non-atomic and return `{ count, items: [{ status: 'ok', item }], errors: [{ status: 'error', index, message }] }`. Use `update_rows` to modify rows or `delete_field` to drop a column.

item.description: Single row delete object containing the primary key (use either `item` or `items`).

items.description: Array of row delete objects for batch deletion (use either `items` or `item`). Each must include PK.

name: delete_rows
